exposure: Early introduction of complementary feeding (before 17 weeks)
exclusive breastfeeding for less than six weeks post-birth
complementary feeding before 6 months of age
outcome: Early introduction of solid foods (before 17 weeks of age)
cohort: 632 mothers of infants aged between 4 and 24 months attending primary health care centers in Saudi Arabia
finding: Complementary feeding prior to 6 months postpartum was common in Saudi Arabia (62.5%), with younger maternal age, Saudi nationality, shorter education, employment within 6 months postpartum, caesarean delivery, not breastfeeding fully for six weeks postpartum, and living in low-income households being associated with early introduction.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with early introduction of complementary feeding.
